svg.title: DEVLOPN Audit — know where your app stands
svg.desc: Before a release, a rewrite or a funding round: understand the risks and decide what to fix first. Three tiers from €990 excl. VAT, delivered in 5 to 10 working days, 8 review areas, report reviewed and signed by Jérémy Favier.

g.text: Before a release, a rewrite or a funding round: understand
the risks and decide what to fix first. You receive a
prioritised report that I review, contextualise and sign.
Specialist AI agents support the analysis.
